names.rationale: Furniture co pivoting to AI is a PAYING CUSTOMER of Cloud Alliance ($400K)+SuperX ($4.8M) on third-party AWS -- a buyer, not a chain supplier. No chain exposure.

watchlist.gradeFact: Through the acquisition of Incal Technology, the introduction of the High Power FOX-XP high-power packaged-part reliability/burn-in test solutions enables Aehr to deliver wafer-level test and burn-in and package-part burn-in for AI accelerators, GPUs, and high-performance computing (HPC) processors, positioning the company as a turn-key provider of reliability and testing for the AI market.
watchlist.rationale: Strongest real exposure -- Sonoma/Incal burn-in purpose-built for AI accelerators/GPUs/HPC (10-K 0001654954-25-008553; packaged-part 2%->34% FY25) but total rev DECLINED 11%, 9mo FY26 annualizes lower, 2 customers=54%, full AI-narrative multiple. Priced-in/flow-chasing twin live, no 3:1.
watchlist.trigger: (a) total revenue inflects UP QoQ; OR (b) two-customer concentration drops materially (a third large AI-accelerator customer named); OR (c) a binding order/backlog quantifying AI-accelerator revenue. [FLAG: buy-ability GENUINELY OPEN pending the valuation-vs-ramp scenario]

watchlist.gradeFact: MaxLinear describes itself as a provider of communications SoCs used in broadband, mobile and wireline infrastructure, data center, and industrial and multi-market applications. Among the example devices it lists 'optical transceivers targeting hyperscale data centers' — a named optical-interconnect chain layer feeding data centers.
watchlist.rationale: Genuinely makes datacenter optical-DSP silicon 400G->1.6T (10-K 0001288469-26-000011) but NO 'Data Center' revenue line (blended in Infrastructure); rev ~30% below 2023 peak, 2 customers=28%, sub-scale vs Marvell/Broadcom. Priced-in twin live, no 3:1.
watchlist.trigger: (a) DC-optical / datacenter revenue broken out as a reportable line; OR (b) a named hyperscaler/OEM 800G/1.6T design win with attributable volume.

watchlist.gradeFact: Adeia's semiconductor IP portfolio covers hybrid bonding (Direct Bond Interconnect / DBI), advanced processing nodes, and advanced packaging solutions, which it states enable the next generation of logic and memory semiconductors 'powering the increasing demand for generative AI applications.' This ties the licensing portfolio to the advanced-packaging / memory layers of the AI-datacenter chain, though no AI-attributable revenue is quantified.
watchlist.rationale: RapidCool is genuine direct-to-chip liquid cooling (10-K 0001193125-26-076549, chain-relevant not label-mismatch) but launched tech with NO licensee/revenue; 'HBM' 0 hits, no HBM royalties; only concrete AI tie is fresh AMD litigation (contingent). Broad-AI twin live, no 3:1.
watchlist.trigger: (a) first RapidCool licensee announced with royalty terms; OR (b) HBM / advanced-packaging royalty stream disclosed or broken out; OR (c) AMD litigation resolves into a licensing outcome.

watchlist.gradeFact: The company operates an Integrated Memory segment (SMART Modular) and references memory market pricing/trends, but the filing does not attribute any quantified revenue to HBM or AI-datacenter memory specifically; memory is described generically.
watchlist.rationale: Most substantive Tier 2 -- genuine AI-infra integration (10-K 0001616533-25-000061: OriginAI GPU-cluster, Advanced Computing +17% to $648M) but 'HBM' 0 hits (SMART Modular=DRAM modules, grade mislabel), AI rev unquantified, 53% sales commodity memory+LED, moderate-margin integrator. Competitive-priced-in twin live, no 3:1.
watchlist.trigger: (a) AI-infrastructure revenue quantified / broken out WITH margin; OR (b) margin expansion in Advanced Computing; OR (c) a multi-year hyperscaler contract with attributable TCV.

watchlist.gradeFact: Fermi is developing Project Matador, a hyperscale power and AI infrastructure campus in the Texas Panhandle, designed to deliver up to 11 GW (expandable to ~17 GW) of private power generation capacity and support up to ~15 million square feet of AI-ready hyperscale compute infrastructure, with the objective of providing hyperscale and other compute-intensive tenants reliable, low-latency power and dedicated powered shell infrastructure. This is disclosed development activity as a colocation/powered-shell operator delivering power to AI datacenters, but the company is development-stage and has generated no revenue.
watchlist.rationale: Purpose-built 11-17GW AI-datacenter power campus but development-stage, ZERO revenue, NO executed leases (only 'negotiating'), CEO/CFO/proxy shakeup. Speculative/binary, no 3:1 -- AVOID control.
watchlist.trigger: (a) first executed AI-datacenter lease/PPA with a named tenant and binding terms; OR (b) financing close for the campus build; OR (c) management stabilization.
